summary.text: Isaac Bryan represents California's 55th Assembly District, which includes the Crenshaw District, Culver City, Ladera Heights, Mar Vista, Pico-Robertson and other communities in West and South Los Angeles.

paragraphs.text: In the Assembly he chairs the Committee on Natural Resources and the Select Committee on The Status of Boys and Men of Color, and in 2024 was elected vice chair of the California Legislative Black Caucus.
Before his election he was founding director of the UCLA Black Policy Project and director of public policy for the UCLA Ralph J. Bunche Center.
